hook.name: HookPadStandardHook
hook.description: A HookPad token launch hook that collects a flat 1% buy/sell tax on every swap, forwards 20% of collected fees to a fixed protocol treasury, and accrues the remaining 80% for the token creator to claim via `claimFees`. Optionally enforces a 60% anti-snipe tax during the first 10 seconds after launch for non-whitelisted buyers.
